title: Odile and the Thorn
author: Ivo Ishikawa
blurb: Theo Thornbury, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
